In the background, several people are queued in a narrow, brightly lit hallway with white walls. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor room with a mahjong table. The man shows a white cardboard box containing multiple small, green rectangular packages to two young women seated at the table. (3) Close-up shots focus on the mahjong tiles and hands moving them across the green felt surface of the table. (4) The man distributes the green packages to various players as rewards. The room is filled with several onlookers standing behind the seated players. (5) A montage follows showing different players, including a man in a grey t-shirt and another in a black tank top, receiving the same green rewards. (6) The final sequence shows the host interviewing a woman in a beige knit top in a hallway near a white door with a 'lucky cat' sticker. He ends the video by laughing close to the lens.
